description: Source code for STM32F7xx HAL Flash memory driver, including functions for programming, erasing, and handling flash memory operations and errors.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Program
methods.description: Programs byte, halfword, word, or double word at a specified address, depending on TypeProgram.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Program_IT
methods.description: Programs flash memory with interrupt enabled at a specified address.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the flash control register for write access.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Lock
methods.description: Locks the flash control register to prevent write access.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_OB_Launch
methods.description: Launches the option byte loading process.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_GetError
methods.description: Returns the current flash error code.
